description: This file defines the AccessTokenEntity class, which implements the AccessTokenEntityInterface for managing OAuth2 access tokens within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for token identifier, expiry, user, client, and scopes, along with methods for setting and getting these properties, and for token serialization.

classes.name: AccessTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token entity with properties for identifier, expiry, user, client, and scopes, and methods to manipulate these properties for token management.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Placeholder method for setting a private key, ignored here as JWT is not used.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns an encrypted string representation of the token identifier.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the token.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time, overriding it to UTC and adding the token TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the user identifier associated with the token.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client entity associated with the token.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the client entity associated with the token.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the token.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns all scopes associated with the token.
